documents.title: Competitive positioning
documents.body:
# Competitive positioning

Use these talking points; do not disparage named competitors.

## Versus generic iPaaS

Northstar Cloud is sold as an agent-ready automation layer. Lead with Agent Fabric and Agentforce connectivity, not connector count.

## Proof points

- Native A2A and MCP registration so Agentforce can call internal knowledge without a custom Apex callout per use case.
- Enterprise SKU required when the customer needs SSO, audit logs, or a sandbox.
- Discount only through Deal Desk; never match a competitor quote on the first call.

## Landmines

Do not discuss unannounced roadmap. If asked about on-prem runtime, say it is available only on Enterprise with a services engagement, then offer a solution architect.

documents.title: Discount and deal desk policy
documents.body:
# Discount and deal desk policy

Standard list pricing applies unless a discount is approved.

## Standard discounts

- Up to 10% for annual prepay on Professional edition.
- Up to 15% for multi-year (36-month) Enterprise agreements.
- Partner-sourced deals may add 5% partner margin, not stacked above 20% total off list.

## Deal desk

Discounts above 15% require Deal Desk approval. Submit the opportunity ID, competitive threat, and estimated close date in Salesforce. Deal Desk SLA is two business days.

Never quote a discount that is not recorded on the opportunity. Agentforce should summarize the policy and tell the seller to open a Deal Desk case for exceptions.

documents.title: Product catalog
documents.body:
# Product catalog

Internal catalog used by sales and support. Prices are list USD per user per month, billed annually unless noted.

## Northstar Cloud Professional

- SKU: NST-PRO
- List: $80
- Includes workflow automation, standard connectors, and 50,000 automation runs per month.
- Best for mid-market teams that need Salesforce and ERP sync.

## Northstar Cloud Enterprise

- SKU: NST-ENT
- List: $140
- Includes Professional features plus SSO, audit logs, sandbox, and unlimited automation runs.
- Required for customers with more than 500 employees or regulated data.

## Add-ons

- Knowledge Pack (SKU: NST-KNOW): $15. Adds managed knowledge search for Agentforce.
- Premium Support (SKU: NST-SUP): $8. 24x7 phone plus 1-hour P1 response.

documents.title: Returns and cancellation policy
documents.body:
# Returns and cancellation policy

Customers may cancel unused annual subscriptions within 30 days of the order start date for a prorated refund. After 30 days, unused months are forfeited unless the contract includes a termination-for-convenience clause.

Implementation services are non-refundable once delivery has started.

Hardware kits (rare) must be returned unused within 14 days with RMA number from Support.

Seller talking point: do not promise refunds beyond this policy. Escalate legal exceptions to RevOps.

documents.title: Support SLA
documents.body:
# Support SLA

Severity is assigned by Support, not by the customer’s requested priority.

## Response targets

- P1 (production outage): 1 hour, 24x7 for Premium Support SKUs; 4 hours business hours otherwise.
- P2 (major feature degraded): 4 business hours.
- P3 (workaround available): 1 business day.
- P4 (how-to / knowledge): 2 business days; prefer Agentforce plus this knowledge agent.

## Case routing

Cases tagged `agentforce` or `knowledge-gap` should cite the knowledge article ID. If no article matches, Support files a knowledge gap in the internal wiki.
